skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Holiday HD31
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD31. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
skins.quote: She's just taking the chance to suntan while on call as an emergency medic—is that an explanation you'd believe?

skins.name: the feast
skins.content: Witch Feast Series/the feast. A custom-made outfit for Warfarin that incorporates holiday designs with Sarkaz motifs. The designer personally embellished this outfit with plenty of jewelry.
